paragraphs.text: Volver is a creature type used for mutant abominations that resulted from the Rathi Overlay .
As a creature type used for a single cycle, Volver has appeared once in each color .
The Volver creature type is unique to a single card cycle in Apocalypse .
When Rath overlayed with Dominaria the merge disrupted the natural flow of magic causing mutations among various creatures, the Volvers are the result of one such mutation.

Volvers were noteworthy in their counter-evolutionary synthesis of three different colors of magic—two allied and one enemy . During the darkest days of the Phyrexian Invasion , when such strange alliances were a necessity, the disciples of the enemy-color schools of wizardry saw these creatures as an affirmation of their studies.
